scenario: A clock mutation is not a sample ([NTST.3.3]): clock_advance sets the mock clock and emits no event, and the next pump samples the clock and emits the one tick that sample records ([LTIM.2.8.5]), then the pump boundary ([RFCS.22]). Two advances between samples leave ONE tick. Strict, so a tick per mutation fails it, and so does a missing first-sample tick. Drives libds's ds_engine_clock_step from ds_engine_pump and the absence of any emit in ds_engine_clock_advance.
